question: \(P(A)=1/2\), \(P(B)=1/3\), and \(P(A\cap B)=1/6\). What is \(P(A\cup B)\)?
solution: When events are not mutually exclusive, subtract the probability of their simultaneous occurrence: \(1/2+1/3-1/6=2/3\).
